notes.title: Patch Notes For Jun 14
notes.content:
Fixed issue where killing an enemy Leader when he's building can cause a crash

NOTE: old save files are now rendered obsolete and deleted upon first launch

notes.title: Patch Notes For Apr 29
notes.content:
Units are now able to rout and leave the map on SP Scandinavia/MP Scandinavia
Added instructions to select multiple Units in army deployment phase
Fixed typos
NOTE: Old save files are not obsolete and will be deleted upon first launch

notes.title: --DEFINITIVE UPDATE--
notes.content:
Happy Autumn!

AcroGames is happy to announce that the development of The Finnish War is coming to an end with this definitive update. After a handful of updates through the year, we are moving on to new challenges!

Of course, one never knows if the need for an update arises still in the unforeseeable future. But for now, this is unlikely.

In this update, you will find:

graphical fixes
audio fixes
minor bug fixes
added 'Scandinavia' multiplayer map to single-player as well (formerly multiplayer-exclusive)
added descriptions for units to the army deployment phase (no more need to memorize unit descriptions from the Help menu!)
old Campaign save files are now obsolete due to certain patch changes and will be deleted automatically on first launch. State of unlocked content (e.g. Factions unlocked from Campaign playthroughs) is not affected

notes.title: Update Notes For Jul 13
notes.content:
Happy Summer To All!

After many months, The Finnish War is treated with a new update, with small gameplay and performance changes here and there.


minor graphical fixes/updates
correct factions assigned to Player and CPU during tutorial
more balanced random army generation for players
old Campaign save files are now obsolete due to certain patch changes and will be deleted automatically on first launch. State of unlocked content (e.g. Factions unlocked from Campaign playthroughs) is not affected
